name: railway__whoami
description: Get the current authenticated Railway user's profile information.

name: railway__list-projects
description: List all Railway projects accessible to the authenticated user.

name: railway__list-services
description: List all services and environments in a Railway project.

name: railway__list-deployments
description: List recent deployments for a Railway project, optionally filtered by environment.

name: railway__get-status
description: Get the deployment status of a Railway project environment. Returns project + environment status.

name: railway__get-logs
description: Get logs from Railway for a deployment — covers deploy (runtime), build, and http logs.

name: railway__redeploy
description: Trigger a redeployment of a service in a given environment.

name: railway__accept-deploy
description: DESTRUCTIVE: Commits all staged changes in a Railway environment and triggers a deploy.

name: railway__railway-agent
description: Send a message to Railway's AI agent for complex infrastructure operations.
